# Accessibility Conformance Report — VPAT® 2.5 (WCAG edition)

**Name of Product** @revealui/presentation 0.13.0  
**Product Description** React component library and design token system.  
**Report Date** 2026-07-28  
**Contact** founder@revealui.com  
**Evaluation Methods Used** Automated testing with axe-core across every component
documentation page in light and dark themes; automated WCAG contrast assertions on every
design token pair; component-level keyboard interaction tests. First-party evaluation — no
independent third-party audit has been performed.

## Applicable standards

| Standard | Included |
|---|---|
| WCAG 2.2 Level A / AA | Yes |
| Revised Section 508 (36 CFR 1194) | Yes, by reference to WCAG 2.2 AA |
| EN 301 549 | Yes, by reference to WCAG 2.2 AA |

## Terms

**Supports** — the functionality meets the criterion without known defects.  
**Partially Supports** — some functionality does not meet the criterion.  
**Does Not Support** — the majority of functionality does not meet the criterion.  
**Not Applicable** — the criterion is not relevant to this product.

> A component library is not an application. Several criteria — page titles, language of
> page, bypass blocks, consistent navigation — are properties of the *consuming*
> application, and are marked Not Applicable here with the obligation noted. A buyer
> assessing a full product needs the consuming application's report as well as this one.
